grounded_facts: Crew members are stationed on Harborview Theater Harborview Theater during a routine sector transition when an emergency interrupts standard operations.
memories.memory_text: I was on the Harborview Theater during a routine sector transition when the emergency alert interrupted standard operations.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers instructs Sage Delaney to amplify the weak distress signal for clearer reception.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Rivers instruct Sage Delaney to amplify the weak signal so we could get a clearer reception.

grounded_facts: Harborview Theater receives a fragmented emergency distress signal from the Kobayashi Maru, reporting it is disabled in the Neutral Zone after striking a gravitic mine.
memories.memory_text: I heard the fragmented distress signal from the Kobayashi Maru reporting that it had struck a gravitic mine and lost all power, with many casualties.

grounded_facts: The distress call identifies the Kobayashi Maru's position as Gamma Hydra, Section Ten, inside the Neutral Zone, escalating the situation's severity.
memories.memory_text: I learned the Kobayashi Maru's position was in Gamma Hydra, Section Ten, deep inside the Neutral Zone, which made the situation even more dangerous.

grounded_facts: Harborview Theater entered the Neutral Zone, triggering a warning from the ship's computer.
memories.memory_text: I heard the computer warn that we had entered the Neutral Zone, and the tension on the Harborview Theater immediately spiked.

grounded_facts: Sensors detect three Klingon cruisers approaching on an attack course.
memories.memory_text: I saw the sensors pick up three Klingon cruisers approaching fast on an attack course, and I knew we were in serious trouble.

grounded_facts: the brass letter is hit multiple times by Klingon photon torpedoes, losing main and auxiliary power, weapons, and life support systems.
memories.memory_text: I was on the Harborview Theater when Harborview Theater took multiple hits from Klingon torpedoes; I saw the power fail, the weapons go down, and I rushed to help Sasha Mercer and Sage Delaney while the ship fell apart around us.

grounded_facts: A simulated starship command scenario designed to test Terry Hawthorne under no-win conditions involving a rescue mission and Klingon attack.
memories.memory_text: I realized the attack and my own death on the Harborview Theater were part of a simulation, though it felt completely real at the time.

grounded_facts: The Harborview Theater walls part to reveal the training simulation environment, ending the scenario.
memories.memory_text: I was on the Harborview Theater responding to casualties when the walls suddenly slid apart, revealing the simulation room and ending the exercise.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers requests to speak candidly and argues the test was unfair due to its unwinnable nature.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Casey Rivers requests to speak candidly and argues the test was unfair due to its unwinnable nature.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson responds to Casey Rivers's complaint about the fairness of the test by teaching her that no-win situations are part of command.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Evan Grayson responds to Casey Rivers's complaint about the fairness of the test by teaching her that no-win situations are part of command.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers expresses her belief that the test was unfair because it was unwinnable, and Evan Grayson teaches her about no-win scenarios.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Casey Rivers expresses her belief that the test was unfair because it was unwinnable, and Evan Grayson teaches her about no-win scenarios.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer questions the value of using Terry Hawthorne, and Evan Grayson responds with a dismissive quip about youth and exploration.
memories.memory_text: I questioned whether using Terry Hawthorne was wise and suggested putting an experienced crew on the ship, but Evan Grayson just told me they'll learn, and that galloping about the cosmos is a game for the young.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer enters Evan Grayson's apartment bearing two packages, one containing Romulan Ale and the other antique reading glasses, initiating a personal and emotionally charged birthday visit.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Graham Mercer enters Evan Grayson's apartment bearing two packages, one containing Romulan Ale and the other antique reading glasses, initiating a personal and emotionally charged birthday visit.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson opens a gift to find antique 'Ben Franklin' half-glasses, which he tries on and discovers improve his vision, symbolizing a moment of personal care and attention from Graham Mercer.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson open the package and try on the glasses, and it meant something to me that they actually helped him see better.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson drinks Romulan Ale, an illegal substance with immediate intoxicating effects, lowering inhibitions and contributing to emotional openness.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson drink Romulan Ale, that illegal substance, and I knew it would hit him fast—it's an instant drunk. I watched him react right after we opened the bottle, and even though I knew it was against the rules, I joined him in drinking it.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer presents Evan Grayson with antique half-glasses tailored to his needs, demonstrating care and deep personal knowledge.
memories.memory_text: I gave Evan Grayson those antique half-glasses because I knew he's been squinting at reports—he needed them, and I wanted him to know I was paying attention.

grounded_facts: A small, informal birthday visit by Graham Mercer to Evan Grayson's apartment, involving gifts, drinking, and emotional conversation.
memories.memory_text: I remember that A small, informal birthday visit by Graham Mercer to Evan Grayson's apartment, involving gifts, drinking, and emotional conversation.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer directly tells Evan Grayson he is hiding from himself by staying in a safe bureaucratic role instead of commanding.
Graham Mercer challenges Evan Grayson's avoidance of personal fulfillment, accusing him of hiding from himself by clinging to duty instead of reclaiming command and living fully.
memories.memory_text: I told Evan Grayson he was hiding from himself behind rules and regulations, that he's avoiding who he really is by staying stuck as an Evan Grayson instead of reclaiming his command and living fully.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer urges Evan Grayson to reclaim his command before it's too late, framing it as a matter of identity and vitality.
memories.memory_text: I urged Evan Grayson to get back his command before it's too late, before he grows old and becomes part of this bureaucratic collection—we both know that's not where he belongs.

grounded_facts: A formal inspection of Harborview Theater's Harborview Theater by Evan Grayson, part of a broader evaluation of the ship's readiness.
memories.memory_text: I watched Evan Grayson begin his inspection of the Harborview Theater, clearly evaluating the ship's readiness during the formal check.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson sternly questions Adrian Marlowe about his confidence in the ship's condition, putting him on the spot.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson put Adrian Marlowe on the spot, sternly questioning his confidence in the ship's condition.

grounded_facts: Adrian Marlowe defiantly asserts Harborview Theater's superiority, even accusing Evan Grayson of blindness.
memories.memory_text: I heard Adrian Marlowe defiantly stand his ground, even accusing Evan Grayson of being blind to Harborview Theater's true condition.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson acknowledges Adrian Marlowe's boldness by calling him a tiger.
Evan Grayson reacts positively to Adrian Marlowe's defiant remark, calling him a tiger, indicating approval of his spirit.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson react with approval when he called Adrian Marlowe a tiger, recognizing the young officer's boldness.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson formally instructs Logan Davenport to prepare the engines for a training cruise, initiating the ship's movement.
Evan Grayson formally authorizes the start of the training cruise by giving the order to Logan Davenport.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson tell Logan Davenport the engines were cleared for a training cruise and that the order was given, so the inspection must be transitioning into active operations.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson declares that the inspection will proceed while the ship is in motion.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Evan Grayson that the inspection would continue once we were underway.

grounded_facts: Taylor Prescott sits in the Evan Grayson's chair and issues orders, indicating he holds command of the Harborview Theater.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Prescott sitting in the Evan Grayson's chair, clearly taking command of the Harborview Theater.

grounded_facts: Taylor Prescott issues a direct order to Casey Rivers to release the ship's moorings.
Taylor Prescott commands Casey Rivers to release the ship's moorings in preparation for departure.
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Prescott directly order Casey Rivers to release all moorings, so I knew departure was beginning.

grounded_facts: The crew prepares the the brass letter for departure from dock under Taylor Prescott's command.
Casey Rivers begins the process of releasing Harborview Theater's moorings by entering data into her console.
memories.memory_text: I stood with Evan Grayson at the rear while I watched Casey Rivers enter the data to release the moorings, part of the crew's preparation for Harborview Theater's departure under Taylor Prescott's command.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer quietly offers Evan Grayson a tranquilizer, showing concern for his state.
memories.memory_text: I quietly offered Evan Grayson a tranquilizer because I could see he was tense and I thought he might need it.

grounded_facts: Sage Delaney interrupts Evan Grayson via comm to inform him of an urgent communication from Elliot York at Fairview Street.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sage Delaney interrupt Evan Grayson over the comm with an urgent message from Elliot York at Fairview Street.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer makes a comment about Romulan ale and remarks on Evan Grayson's silence, later apologizing for reopening old wounds.
memories.memory_text: I commented on how wonderful Romulan ale is and noticed Evan Grayson's silence, then later realized I might have brought up something painful, so I said sorry.

grounded_facts: Harborview Theater changes course to Fairview Street under Evan Grayson's orders.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Evan Grayson take command and order us to change course to Fairview Street.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson declares an emergency and assumes command of Harborview Theater by order of Harbor Point Department.
Evan Grayson announces he is assuming command of Harborview Theater by Harbor Point Department order.
A formal shift in command on Harborview Theater Harborview Theater initiated by Evan Grayson under Harbor Point Department authority.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Evan Grayson declare an emergency and announce he was assuming command of Harborview Theater by order of Harbor Point Department, marking a formal shift in authority on the Harborview Theater.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson informs Logan Davenport that the ship will go to warp speed.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson say we'd be going to warp speed, informing Logan Davenport over the comm.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson instructs Sasha Mercer to activate warp engines and proceed to Warp 5.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson order Sasha Mercer to take the ship to Warp 5 while I was on the Harborview Theater.

grounded_facts: Harborview Theater engages warp engines and accelerates to Warp 5.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Sasha Mercer engaging the warp engines and felt the ship accelerate to Warp 5.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson decides to bring Graham Mercer into the discussion and moves the conversation to his quarters.
memories.memory_text: I was told to join Evan Grayson and Taylor Prescott in his quarters for a private discussion about the glass notebook.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson uses his Class 1 security clearance to request and obtain access to the the glass notebook summary from the ship's computer.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson dim the lights and use his Class 1 security clearance to request access to the the glass notebook summary from the ship's computer.

grounded_facts: A recorded presentation by Elliot York explaining the the glass notebook, played for Evan Grayson, Taylor Prescott, and Graham Mercer aboard Harborview Theater.
memories.memory_text: I watched the recorded presentation by Elliot York explaining the the glass notebook, where she described how the device could restructure matter to create life on a lifeless planet, and I reacted with wonder along with Evan Grayson and Taylor Prescott.

grounded_facts: The crew watches a recorded simulation of the the glass notebook's planetary-scale effect, showing the transformation of a lifeless moon into a habitable planet.
memories.memory_text: I watched the simulation with the crew, and I saw how the the glass notebook could transform a dead moon into a living planet right before my eyes.

grounded_facts: Taylor Prescott confirms the scientific accuracy of the the glass notebook effect after the playback, stating 'It literally is the glass notebook...'
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Prescott confirm after the playback that the effect was scientifically accurate, saying 'It literally is the glass notebook...'

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson attempts to halt the escalating argument between Taylor Prescott and Graham Mercer over the glass notebook.
memories.memory_text: I remember Evan Grayson trying to stop our argument, stepping in with 'Gentlemen, this isn't --' just as things were heating up between me and Taylor Prescott.

grounded_facts: After viewing the the glass notebook tape, Taylor Prescott and Graham Mercer debate the scientific and ethical consequences of the technology, with Graham Mercer expressing alarm over its destructive potential.
memories.memory_text: After seeing the the glass notebook tape, I confronted Taylor Prescott about its destructive power, asking him if he had any idea what it meant to wipe out existing life for a new matrix — I couldn't believe he was so calm about universal Armageddon.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer confronts Taylor Prescott about the moral dangers of the glass notebook, accusing him of being indifferent to universal destruction.
memories.memory_text: I accused Taylor Prescott of being indifferent to the moral dangers of the glass notebook, calling him cold-blooded because he wouldn't say whose hands were the right ones to wield such power.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers reports via intercom that the the small photograph is detected in the vicinity and closing fast.
Casey Rivers informs Evan Grayson via intercom that the the small photograph has been detected approaching their position.
memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Rivers report over the intercom that the the small photograph was detected nearby and closing fast, and then she confirmed it was one of our ships.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson, Graham Mercer, and Taylor Prescott take their positions on Harborview Theater Harborview Theater after entering.
The crew is assembled on Harborview Theater Harborview Theater conducting active command operations.
memories.memory_text: I remember stepping onto the Harborview Theater with Evan Grayson and Taylor Prescott, taking my post as the crew assembled and we began active command operations.

grounded_facts: A medical alert is announced from the Harborview Theater, prompting Graham Mercer to leave urgently.
memories.memory_text: I heard the intercom announce a medical alert from the Harborview Theater, and I dashed out immediately to respond.

grounded_facts: A post-attack medical emergency in the sick bay with multiple casualties, where Evan Grayson assesses the situation and receives updates on ship status.
memories.memory_text: I was in sick bay treating multiple casualties after the attack, doing what I could while Evan Grayson assessed the situation and checked in on ship status.

grounded_facts: Crewman Adrian Marlowe dies after confirming the order to go to warp speed, having remained at his post during the crisis.
Evan Grayson softly confirms to dying Adrian Marlowe that the order to go to warp speed has been given.
memories.memory_text: I was working on Crewman Adrian Marlowe when he asked if the order to go to warp speed had been given, and I heard Evan Grayson softly confirm it; I saw Adrian Marlowe almost smile before he died.

grounded_facts: Logan Davenport silently looks at Evan Grayson across Adrian Marlowe's body and asks 'WHY?', expressing grief and implied blame.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Davenport standing by Adrian Marlowe's body, his lips trembling, and then he looked at Evan Grayson and silently asked 'WHY?' with such grief and accusation in his eyes.

grounded_facts: Logan Davenport acknowledges Graham Mercer' efforts to save Adrian Marlowe, thanking him before leaving.
memories.memory_text: I remember Logan Davenport thanking me for trying to save Adrian Marlowe, and he squeezed my shoulder before limping off.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson asks Graham Mercer if he is all right after Adrian Marlowe's death.
memories.memory_text: I remember Evan Grayson asking me if I was all right after Adrian Marlowe died.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson admits to Graham Mercer that he was outmatched in the confrontation with the antagonist, surviving only due to superior knowledge of the ship.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson admit to me that he was outmatched, saying he only got out alive because he knew something about the ship that the other man didn't.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson makes the decision to go down to the Fairview Street despite the risks and lack of sensor information.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson decide to beam down to the Fairview Street despite the risks and lack of sensor information.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer attempts to dissuade Evan Grayson from beaming down by reminding him that Elliot Carver could be on the station.
memories.memory_text: I tried to stop Evan Grayson from going because I told him Elliot Carver could be down there.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers formally objects to Evan Grayson's plan by referencing General Order 15, which prohibits flag officers from entering hazardous areas without armed escort.
memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Rivers formally object to Evan Grayson's plan by citing General Order 15, which prohibits flag officers from entering hazardous areas without an armed escort.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson formally assigns command of Harborview Theater to Taylor Prescott before departing for the station.
Taylor Prescott expresses personal concern for Evan Grayson's safety as he departs.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson hand over command to Taylor Prescott before he left, and I heard Taylor Prescott tell him to be careful—I could tell he was worried about Evan Grayson's safety.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson, Casey Rivers, and Graham Mercer materialize in Fairview Street on the Fairview Street, finding it empty and eerie.
memories.memory_text: I materialized in Fairview Street with Evan Grayson and Casey Rivers, and I immediately noticed how empty and eerie it felt.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson calls out to see if anyone is present, receiving only an echo in response.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson call out, 'Hello...! Anybody here?' and we only got an echo back.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers detects ambiguous life signs using her tricorder.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Rivers raise her tricorder and report indeterminate life signs.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson orders the team to set their the leather case to stun as a precaution.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson order us to set our the leather case to stun before moving out.

grounded_facts: The team separates and begins searching the lab.
memories.memory_text: I was with the team when we separated to search the lab.

grounded_facts: A team-led investigation of the abandoned lab on the Fairview Street to locate life signs and gather data.
memories.memory_text: I was part of the team searching the abandoned lab to locate life signs and gather data, so we split up to cover more ground.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers begins interacting with the data bank to retrieve information.
memories.memory_text: I saw Casey Rivers move to the data bank and start keying in sequences to retrieve information.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer and Evan Grayson explore a deserted section of the Fairview Street, searching for clues and survivors, culminating in the discovery of hanged crew members.
memories.memory_text: I was exploring the deserted section of the station with Evan Grayson, searching for clues or survivors, and I got startled when a rat ran past me and then something fell on my face—an arm, hanging upside down—which led us to find the bodies.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson expresses shock that even the Lane Sterling was killed, emphasizing the brutality of the attack.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Evan Grayson that they even killed the Lane Sterling, and I remember his stunned reaction.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer informs Evan Grayson that one of the victims appears to be a Elliot North, adding to their understanding of who was killed.
memories.memory_text: I told Evan Grayson that this one looks like a Elliot North, based on what I could see from the body.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer discovers five bodies hanging upside down in the Fairview Street, which causes initial shock but leads to a forensic assessment of the time of death.
memories.memory_text: I saw five bodies hanging upside down, and after recovering my composure, I helped Evan Grayson cut down the last one and examined the corpses, recognizing some of them, and I noted that one of them looked like a Elliot North.

grounded_facts: After examining the corpses, Graham Mercer concludes that rigor mortis has not set in, indicating the killings occurred recently.
memories.memory_text: I examined the bodies and concluded that rigor hasn't set in, so I told Evan Grayson the killings didn't happen all that long ago.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers, Evan Grayson, and Graham Mercer discover the unconscious bodies of Finley Hollis and Darian Hollis after opening a sealed compartment.
memories.memory_text: I was with Casey Rivers and Evan Grayson when we heard a sound and her tricorder alerted us; we opened a compartment and found Finley Hollis and Darian Hollis lying there unconscious, their bodies just falling out.

grounded_facts: An urgent situation unfolds in the Riverside School lab data bank as crew members are discovered unconscious and require immediate medical attention.
memories.memory_text: I remember the urgency in the air when we found Finley Hollis and Darian Hollis unconscious—I immediately started scanning Finley Hollis with my tricorder and heard him moan, knowing he needed medical attention right away.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer uses his tricorder to assess Finley Hollis and identifies a drug-induced brain disturbance, then administers treatment.
memories.memory_text: I used my tricorder to scan Finley Hollis and saw he had a brain disturbance that I believed was drug-induced, so I gave him treatment from my kit before moving on to check Darian Hollis.

grounded_facts: Finley Hollis wakes up and recognizes Evan Grayson, showing emotional distress.
Finley Hollis weeps and is held by Evan Grayson after waking, showing trust and emotional dependence.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Hollis wake up and look right at Evan Grayson, calling out to him like a scared child before breaking down and being held.

grounded_facts: Darian Hollis wakes up and recognizes Graham Mercer, indicating recovery from mind control.
memories.memory_text: I saw Darian Hollis open his eyes and stare at me, so I asked if he remembered me to make sure he was really coming back from that mind control.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer takes over comforting Finley Hollis, affirming his safety.
memories.memory_text: I stepped in and told Finley Hollis it was all right and that he was safe, wanting him to know I was there to protect him.

grounded_facts: Darian Hollis reports that the small photograph crew is stranded on Ceti Alpha V.
memories.memory_text: I heard Darian Hollis say the small photograph crew was stranded on Ceti Alpha V, with no resources left.

grounded_facts: Finley Hollis states that Elliot Carver left them behind, no longer finding them useful.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Finley Hollis that Elliot Carver left them behind, saying they were no longer of use.

grounded_facts: A gathering of liberated crew members providing intelligence to Evan Grayson after being freed from Elliot Carver's control.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Finley Hollis and Darian Hollis that they had been forced to lie and do things under Elliot Carver's control, but resisted, and that Elliot Carver had gone mad and was now marooned on Ceti Alpha V.

grounded_facts: Darian Hollis states Elliot Carver blames Evan Grayson for his wife's death, implying Evan Grayson is the root of the attack.
memories.memory_text: I learned from Darian Hollis that Elliot Carver blames Evan Grayson for his wife's death, which is why he's attacking.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson explains to Casey Rivers that the transporter being left on implies someone escaped before the others died.
Evan Grayson discovers the transporter unit was left on, implying someone used it before the crew died.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson examine the transporter console and heard him tell Casey Rivers that since the unit was left on, someone must have escaped before the others died.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson realizes that if Stage Two of the glass notebook was completed, it must have been done underground on Fairview Street.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson say that if Stage Two of the glass notebook was completed, it must have been done underground on Fairview Street, since she mentioned it would be underground.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson gives Taylor Prescott contingency orders to leave for Star Base if no contact is made within one hour.
Evan Grayson orders Taylor Prescott to restore power and leave for Star Base if no contact is made within one hour.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Evan Grayson gave orders for Taylor Prescott to restore power and leave for Star Base if we didn't make contact within one hour.

grounded_facts: Darian Hollis states he and Finley Hollis would like to share the risk and accompany Evan Grayson.
memories.memory_text: I heard Darian Hollis tell Evan Grayson that he and Finley Hollis wanted to share the risk and accompany him down to Fairview Street.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson asks Finley Hollis and Darian Hollis if the missing person made it to the transporter room.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson ask Finley Hollis and Darian Hollis if the missing person made it to the transporter room, and I listened to their responses.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson, Casey Rivers, Graham Mercer, Finley Hollis, and Darian Hollis prepare to beam down to the coordinates on Fairview Street.
memories.memory_text: I joined Evan Grayson, Casey Rivers, Finley Hollis, and Darian Hollis on the transporter pads as we prepared to beam down to Fairview Street, and I remember the moment we all vanished during transport.

grounded_facts: A team assembles and transports from the Fairview Street to an underground location on Fairview Street based on coordinates from the the glass notebook.
memories.memory_text: I was part of the team that assembled and transported from the Fairview Street to an underground location on Fairview Street, following the the glass notebook coordinates.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson discovers that Noel Vale is his son after Elliot York confirms it during a confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I realized in that moment that Noel Vale must be Evan Grayson's son — Elliot York's words made it clear, though no one said it outright.

grounded_facts: Elliot York tells Noel Vale that killing Evan Grayson would mean murdering his father, revealing their biological relationship.
memories.memory_text: I heard Elliot York tell Noel Vale that if he killed Evan Grayson, he'd be murdering his own father — she said it plainly, right there in front of me.

grounded_facts: Darian Hollis speaks into his wrist recorder, informing Elliot Carver of the situation.
memories.memory_text: I remember Darian Hollis speaking into his wrist recorder, asking Elliot Carver if he had been listening, confirming he was reporting to him.

grounded_facts: Darian Hollis disarms Morgan Mercer, takes control of the situation, and reveals allegiance to Elliot Carver by reporting to him.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Darian Hollis had turned against us when he disarmed Morgan Mercer, took control, and reported to Elliot Carver, who responded by praising him.

grounded_facts: Darian Hollis takes Morgan Mercer's the leather case and orders everyone not to move, establishing dominance.
Finley Hollis raises his the leather case against Evan Grayson and the others, confirming his allegiance to Darian Hollis and Elliot Carver.
memories.memory_text: I saw Darian Hollis take Morgan Mercer's the leather case and shout 'Don't move -- any of you!' while Finley Hollis raised his the leather case at Evan Grayson, making it clear they were both against us.

grounded_facts: A tense standoff occurs in a cavern on Ceti Alpha V, where Elliot Carver attempts to command Darian Hollis and Finley Hollis to kill Evan Grayson.
Elliot Carver orders Darian Hollis to kill Evan Grayson, intensifying the psychological and physical conflict.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed a tense standoff in a cavern on Ceti Alpha V where Elliot Carver commanded Darian Hollis to kill Evan Grayson, shouting 'Kill him' and then 'Kill him, Darian Hollis. Now.'

grounded_facts: Darian Hollis kills himself under Elliot Carver's command after resisting the order to kill Evan Grayson.
memories.memory_text: I saw Darian Hollis turn his the leather case on himself and die after resisting Elliot Carver's order to kill Evan Grayson.

grounded_facts: The Ceti eel emerges from Finley Hollis's ear and is destroyed by Evan Grayson.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Ceti eel emerge from Finley Hollis's ear and crawl out, already grown quite large, and I watched in horror as Evan Grayson fired his the leather case and destroyed it.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson seizes the communicator and directly challenges Elliot Carver, declaring his agents defeated.
Evan Grayson seizes Elliot Carver's communicator and declares that Elliot Carver's agents are dead and he must act himself.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson seize Elliot Carver's communicator and shout at him that his agents were finished, telling him he’d have to do his own dirty work now.

grounded_facts: A gathering in the rocky cavern where survivors assess their situation after the battle.
Finley Hollis stirs and attempts to sit up, indicating he is alive and recovering from injury.
memories.memory_text: I was in the rocky cavern with the others after the battle, and when I saw Finley Hollis stir and try to sit up, I went over to tend to him and called out, 'He's alive!'

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers reports that all channels are jammed and the brass letter cannot be reached.
memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Rivers report that all channels were jammed and we couldn't reach Harborview Theater.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer states that if the brass letter obeyed orders, she has left; if not, she is destroyed.
memories.memory_text: I said it wouldn't make any difference—if Harborview Theater obeyed orders, she's long gone, and if she didn't, she's finished.

grounded_facts: Noel Vale blames Evan Grayson for a man's death, expressing bitterness over their relationship.
memories.memory_text: I heard Noel Vale blame my Evan Grayson for a man's death, and I could sense the bitterness in his voice toward Evan Grayson.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer counters Noel Vale's accusation by blaming him for reckless action leading to two deaths.
memories.memory_text: I told Noel Vale it was his own reckless action that caused the deaths, not Evan Grayson's doing, and reminded him that two men were dead, not just one.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson asks if there is food, shifting focus from despair to survival.
Evan Grayson asks for food, redirecting the group's attention from despair to practical survival.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson ask if anyone had food, and I could see he was trying to shift everyone’s focus from despair to survival by getting us to think about eating.

grounded_facts: Elliot York informs the group that there is ample food in the the glass notebook cave.
memories.memory_text: I remember Elliot York telling the group that there was enough food in the the glass notebook cave to last a lifetime, which gave us some hope.

grounded_facts: Elliot York tells Noel Vale to show the others the food source in the the glass notebook cave.
memories.memory_text: I heard Elliot York tell Noel Vale to show the others the food source in the the glass notebook cave.

grounded_facts: Noel Vale is asked to lead Graham Mercer and Casey Rivers to the food in the the glass notebook cave.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Noel Vale was asked to lead me and Casey Rivers to the food in the the glass notebook cave, though it felt like just something to keep us busy.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer tells Noel Vale that Evan Grayson is the only cadet to beat the no-win scenario, establishing Evan Grayson's legendary status.
memories.memory_text: I told Casey Rivers that Evan Grayson is the only cadet who ever beat the no-win scenario, wanting her to understand just how legendary he really is.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson answers Casey Rivers's question by revealing he cheated the Kobayashi Maru simulation, asserting his belief in overcoming impossible odds.
Evan Grayson discloses that he beat the no-win scenario by reprogramming the simulation, revealing his aversion to losing and demonstrating a history of rule-breaking for success.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Evan Grayson answered Casey Rivers's question by revealing he reprogrammed the Kobayashi Maru simulation to make it winnable, saying he doesn't like to lose and even got a commendation for original thinking.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson contacts Taylor Prescott to begin extraction, signaling the end of their time on the glass notebook.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson contact Taylor Prescott to begin extraction, telling him it was two hours and asking if he was ready, which meant our time on the glass notebook was finally coming to an end.

grounded_facts: Taylor Prescott contacts Evan Grayson to confirm he is on schedule and ready to beam the team aboard, marking a transition from survival to rescue.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Taylor Prescott respond to Evan Grayson, confirming he was on schedule and ready to beam us aboard, marking the moment we shifted from just surviving to actually being rescued.

grounded_facts: A philosophical discussion about the no-win scenario emerges among Evan Grayson, Casey Rivers, Graham Mercer, and Noel Vale, focusing on how one faces defeat and death.
memories.memory_text: I remember joining Evan Grayson, Casey Rivers, and Noel Vale for a meal where we ended up talking about the no-win scenario and how a commander faces defeat and death.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson, Noel Vale, Casey Rivers, Elliot York, Graham Mercer, and Finley Hollis materialize in the transporter room after being transported from another location.
memories.memory_text: I materialized in the transporter room with Evan Grayson, Noel Vale, Casey Rivers, Elliot York, and Finley Hollis, and I was holding Finley Hollis because he was semi-conscious and needed medical attention.

grounded_facts: The returning crew reunites with Taylor Prescott aboard Harborview Theater following a mission.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Prescott waiting for us in the transporter room when we arrived back on Harborview Theater.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson reminds Casey Rivers of Regulation 46-A to justify Taylor Prescott's actions during battle.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson remind Casey Rivers about Regulation 46-A to justify Taylor Prescott's actions during the battle.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers directly accuses Taylor Prescott of lying about the ship's status, challenging his integrity.
Casey Rivers confronts Taylor Prescott, accusing him of lying about the ship's status during battle.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Casey Rivers confront Taylor Prescott and accuse him of lying about the ship's status during battle.

grounded_facts: Taylor Prescott explains that he exaggerated the repair time to mislead the enemy, not lied.
Taylor Prescott admits to exaggerating the repair timeline to protect the ship during battle.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Prescott admit he exaggerated the repair timeline to mislead the enemy, not lied, in order to protect the ship.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer announces he is taking Finley Hollis and others to sick bay for medical care.
memories.memory_text: I announced that I'm taking Finley Hollis and the others to sick bay for medical care.

grounded_facts: An emergency situation in the hospital triggered by light changes and sirens, during which Finley Hollis is being treated.
memories.memory_text: I saw the lights change and heard the sirens go off while I was treating Finley Hollis, so I knew we were in the middle of a hospital emergency.

grounded_facts: Noel Vale decides to go to another location on the battleship despite Graham Mercer' objection.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Vale decide to go up on the battleship even after I told him to stay.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer advises Noel Vale not to go up, telling him he will be in the way.
memories.memory_text: I told Noel Vale he'd be in the way if he went up there, and advised him to stay where he was.

grounded_facts: Finley Hollis wakes and attempts to get up despite physical weakness, indicating urgency or distress.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Hollis wake up and try to get out of bed, looking frantic and saying, 'But I must --', clearly in distress despite being weak.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer tells Finley Hollis he lacks the strength and balance to get up.
memories.memory_text: I told Finley Hollis, 'Listen to me, Finley Hollis; you haven't the strength or the equilibrium,' because I knew he couldn't safely stand.

grounded_facts: Elliot York expresses inability to remain passive and asks Graham Mercer for a task.
Elliot York asks Graham Mercer what she can do to help during the crisis.
memories.memory_text: I heard Elliot York tell me she couldn't just sit there and asked me what she could do to help.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer states he expects incoming patients and directs Elliot York to help prepare the surgical area.
Graham Mercer directs Elliot York to help prepare the surgery area for incoming patients.
memories.memory_text: I told Elliot York she could help get my surgery squared away because I was expecting customers.

grounded_facts: The ship experiences repeated near misses, creating a crisis environment in the hospital.
memories.memory_text: I remember the ship shaking from repeated near misses—the first one reverberating through the hull, then getting hit again and again—making everything unstable in the hospital.

grounded_facts: A critical situation in Harborview Theater Harborview Theater caused by uncontrolled radiation, requiring immediate intervention.
memories.memory_text: I was treating Logan Davenport in the Harborview Theater when I saw the radiation levels were critical and realized no one could survive in that reactor room.

grounded_facts: Taylor Prescott uses the Vulcan nerve pinch on Graham Mercer to prevent further interference with his plan to enter the radiation room.
memories.memory_text: I felt the sharp pressure of Taylor Prescott's fingers on my neck before everything went black — he used the Vulcan nerve pinch to knock me out so I couldn't stop him.

grounded_facts: Taylor Prescott decides to enter the highly radioactive reactor room despite warnings, using the Vulcan nerve pinch to incapacitate Graham Mercer when intercepted.
Taylor Prescott dismisses Graham Mercer' medical warning and physically neutralizes him to proceed with his plan.
memories.memory_text: I confronted Taylor Prescott when he tried to enter the radiation room, telling him he'd die in there, but he said he wasn't human and couldn't stop to discuss it — then he used the nerve pinch on me and went inside anyway.

grounded_facts: Logan Davenport expresses horror and urges Taylor Prescott to leave the reactor room upon seeing him enter.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Logan Davenport shout 'Taylor Prescott -- get out of there!' when he saw Taylor Prescott enter the reactor room, his voice filled with horror.

grounded_facts: Logan Davenport screams at Evan Grayson to intervene and stop Taylor Prescott from entering the reactor chamber.
memories.memory_text: I heard Logan Davenport shout at Evan Grayson, begging him to stop Taylor Prescott, and I knew he felt it too—that we were losing him and no one could do a damn thing.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer desperately urges Evan Grayson to get Taylor Prescott out of the reactor chamber.
memories.memory_text: I screamed at Evan Grayson to get Taylor Prescott out of that chamber—he was walking into certain death and no one was stopping him.

grounded_facts: Outside the glass, Graham Mercer and Logan Davenport silently express desperate concern and horror as they watch Taylor Prescott suffer.
memories.memory_text: I stood there with Logan Davenport, frozen behind the glass, watching Taylor Prescott suffer and feeling utterly helpless—I wanted to pull him out myself but could only stand and watch.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer contacts Evan Grayson with an urgent and frightening tone, telling him to come quickly.
Graham Mercer contacts Evan Grayson with an urgent tone, prompting immediate action.
memories.memory_text: I contacted Evan Grayson with an urgent tone, telling him to come quickly, and I could tell my message frightened him into immediate action.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson instructs Casey Rivers to take command of the Harborview Theater before leaving.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Evan Grayson instructed Casey Rivers to take command of the Harborview Theater before leaving.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson leaves the Harborview Theater after assigning command to Casey Rivers.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Evan Grayson left the Harborview Theater after assigning command to Casey Rivers, though I didn't see it happen myself.

grounded_facts: An urgent repair operation in Harborview Theater's reactor room following a critical failure, resulting in Taylor Prescott's fatal radiation exposure.
memories.memory_text: I saw the flashing light and Logan Davenport's face—Taylor Prescott was already in the reactor room, fixing the warp core, and I knew he'd been exposed to lethal radiation.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer physically stops Evan Grayson from attempting to enter the reactor room, knowing it would be suicidal.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed Evan Grayson when he tried to rush to the reactor room—I knew it was too late and he'd only get himself killed.

grounded_facts: Taylor Prescott's first concern upon contact is whether the ship is safe, and he is satisfied when Evan Grayson confirms it is.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Prescott's first concern was the ship's safety, and he seemed satisfied when Evan Grayson confirmed it was out of danger.

grounded_facts: Taylor Prescott reveals he never took the Kobayashi Maru test until now, framing his sacrifice as his solution.
memories.memory_text: I remember Taylor Prescott saying he never took the Kobayashi Maru test until that moment, and I realized he was calling his sacrifice the answer all along.

grounded_facts: Taylor Prescott communicates his enduring friendship and peace with his choice before dying.
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Prescott tell Evan Grayson, 'I have been—and always will be—your friend,' and those words hung in the air like a promise neither of them could keep.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson places his hand on the glass opposite Taylor Prescott's, creating a silent, emotional connection in their final moment.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson press his hand against the glass, matching Taylor Prescott's, and I could feel the weight of that moment—he was saying goodbye without words.

grounded_facts: Taylor Prescott dies from radiation poisoning after saving Harborview Theater by repairing the warp core.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Prescott fall after being exposed to lethal radiation, and I knew—no matter what I wanted—there was nothing I could do to save him.

grounded_facts: A formal Harbor Point Department burial ceremony held in Riverside School to honor a fallen crew member, coinciding with the birth of a new planet.
The crew assembles in full dress uniforms for a formal burial service in Riverside School, honoring a fallen comrade.
memories.memory_text: I stood with the crew in full dress uniform during a formal Harbor Point Department burial ceremony in Riverside School, honoring a fallen comrade while a new planet was being born.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson speaks about the significance of the sacrifice, linking the death to the birth of a new world, and emotionally declares the deceased's soul as the most human he has encountered.
memories.memory_text: I listened as Evan Grayson spoke about the sacrifice, linking the death to the birth of a new world, and when he said the deceased's soul was the most human he had ever encountered, I felt the weight of those words deeply.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson, overcome with emotion, signals Casey Rivers to continue the burial service after failing to complete his eulogy.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson struggle with his emotions during the eulogy, and when he couldn't continue, I noticed him signal Casey Rivers to take over the service.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers formally commends the soul of the deceased and commits the body to Riverside School.
memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Rivers commend the soul of our departed brother and commit his body to the depths of Riverside School during the service.

grounded_facts: Sasha Mercer commands the crew to render honors as part of the burial ritual.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sasha Mercer command the crew to render honors, and I came to attention when he called out 'Honors -- hup!'.

grounded_facts: The deceased's body is committed to Riverside School via a black capsule launched from the ship.
memories.memory_text: I watched as the black capsule carrying the deceased was launched into Riverside School from the ship's chamber.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson enters Harborview Theater Harborview Theater accompanied by Noel Vale, introducing a significant familial revelation.
Evan Grayson introduces Noel Vale as his son to Casey Rivers, marking a personal disclosure with emotional weight.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson walk onto the Harborview Theater with a young man, and then he introduced him as his son—that hit me hard, a real personal moment for him.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers delivers a deadpan joke calling Noel Vale a 'dumb bastard', then clarifies it is a joke.
memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Rivers tell Noel Vale he was a 'dumb bastard,' and then she deadpanned that it was a joke—I couldn't help but notice how dry her delivery was.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer suggests the planet might be named after Elliot York; she responds it should be named for their friend (implied: Taylor Prescott).
memories.memory_text: I suggested the planet might be named after Elliot York, and she said it should be named for our friend instead.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer asks Evan Grayson how he feels, showing concern for his emotional and physical state.
memories.memory_text: I asked Evan Grayson how he felt, wanting to make sure he was okay after everything we'd been through.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson orders a new course using a literary phrase, signaling a shift in mission tone or emotional direction.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson give a new course order using that literary phrase—'Second star to the right and straight on till morning'—and I could feel the shift in the whole mood around the Harborview Theater.

grounded_facts: Crew is on duty on Harborview Theater Harborview Theater while en route to Ceti Alpha, engaging in routine and personal exchanges.
memories.memory_text: I was on the Harborview Theater with the crew en route to Ceti Alpha, and even though we were on duty, there was a lot of chatter and some personal moments mixed in.

grounded_facts: Sage Delaney detects and reports a weak but identifiable distress signal, later confirmed as originating from the Kobayashi Maru.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Sage Delaney detects and reports a weak but identifiable distress signal, later confirmed as originating from the Kobayashi Maru.

grounded_facts: Harborview Theater receives a fragmented distress signal from the Kobayashi Maru, reporting it is disabled in the Neutral Zone after striking a gravitic mine.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Harborview Theater receives a fragmented distress signal from the Kobayashi Maru, reporting it is disabled in the Neutral Zone after striking a gravitic mine.

grounded_facts: A command situation on Harborview Theater Harborview Theater initiated by the reception of a distress signal from the Kobayashi Maru within the Neutral Zone, prompting tactical assessment and navigational response.
memories.memory_text: I remember that A command situation on Harborview Theater Harborview Theater initiated by the reception of a distress signal from the Kobayashi Maru within the Neutral Zone, prompting tactical assessment and navigational response.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer questions whether using Terry Hawthorne was wise, implying criticism of Evan Grayson's decision.
memories.memory_text: I questioned whether using Terry Hawthorne was wise, wondering aloud if it wouldn't be easier to put an experienced crew back on the ship.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer presents Evan Grayson with a bottle of illegal Romulan Ale as a birthday gift, using humor and medical justification.
memories.memory_text: I gave Evan Grayson a bottle of Romulan Ale for his birthday, making a joke about 'beware Romulans bearing gifts' before pouring us both a drink, even though it's illegal—I figured a special occasion called for it.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer visits Evan Grayson on his birthday and gives him two gifts: a bottle of Romulan Ale and a pair of antique 'Ben Franklin' half-glasses.
memories.memory_text: I visited Evan Grayson on his birthday and gave him two gifts—I brought a bottle of Romulan Ale and a pair of antique 'Ben Franklin' half-glasses, and I told him to open the second one after he saw the ale.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson learns how to use the antique half-glasses, which restore his ability to read without strain, symbolizing a small reclaiming of personal capability.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson's face light up when he realized he could read again without straining—he said it was amazing, and I could tell he meant it.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer teaches Evan Grayson how to properly wear and use the antique half-glasses.
memories.memory_text: I showed Evan Grayson how to wear those old half-glasses—told him to slide them down his nose and look over the top, read through the bottom. It worked just like I hoped.

grounded_facts: A private birthday visit by Graham Mercer to Evan Grayson's apartment, involving gift-giving, drinking, and emotional confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I visited Evan Grayson at his apartment for his birthday, brought him two gifts, we had a few drinks, and I called him out when he started acting distant—told him he was hiding behind rules like always, because I care about him as both his doctor and his friend.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer challenges Evan Grayson's passive acceptance of desk duty and emotional isolation, urging him to reclaim his command before it's too late.
memories.memory_text: I challenged Evan Grayson about how he's just sitting at a desk when he should be out exploring the galaxy—he doesn't belong stuck behind a console, and I told him he's hiding from himself, hiding behind rules and regulations, as his friend and doctor.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer directly tells Evan Grayson that he is hiding from himself by staying in a safe administrative role.
memories.memory_text: I told Evan Grayson directly that he's hiding from himself, hiding behind rules and regulations, and I called him out on it as his friend and doctor.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson and his staff formally board Harborview Theater, marking the beginning of his inspection.
Evan Grayson formally requests permission to come aboard, and Taylor Prescott welcomes him.
A formal inspection of Harborview Theater initiated by Evan Grayson upon boarding.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson and his staff formally board Harborview Theater, and I witnessed him request permission to come aboard, which Taylor Prescott granted, marking the start of his inspection.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson makes a dry comment to Casey Rivers about their shared experience with death and life, which she does not react to well.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson make a dry comment to Casey Rivers about their shared experience with death and life, and I noticed she didn't react well to it.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson warmly greets Logan Davenport, showing familiarity and concern.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson warmly greet Logan Davenport, asking how he was, and I heard Logan Davenport mention that I had pulled him through a recent illness, which made me recall my role in his recovery.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson engages with Midshipman Adrian Marlowe, acknowledging his enthusiasm.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson engage with Midshipman Adrian Marlowe, acknowledging the young man's enthusiasm as he introduced himself formally.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson decides to continue the inspection once the ship is in motion.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Evan Grayson that the inspection would continue once we were underway.

grounded_facts: Sasha Mercer verbally alerts the Harborview Theater that Evan Grayson has entered, fulfilling protocol.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sasha Mercer announce that Evan Grayson had entered the Harborview Theater, following protocol as usual.

grounded_facts: Taylor Prescott, seated in the Evan Grayson's chair, gives an order to prepare for departure, indicating his assumption of command authority on the Harborview Theater.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Taylor Prescott, seated in the Evan Grayson's chair, gives an order to prepare for departure, indicating his assumption of command authority on the Harborview Theater.

grounded_facts: A coordinated Harborview Theater activity to prepare the the brass letter for authorized departure under Taylor Prescott's command.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the Harborview Theater crew preparing Harborview Theater for departure under Taylor Prescott's command, with him in the Evan Grayson's chair and giving orders to clear moorings.

grounded_facts: Harbor Point Department authorizes the the brass letter to leave its dock.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Harbor Point Department must have authorized the the brass letter to leave its dock since Taylor Prescott gave the order to clear moorings.

grounded_facts: Taylor Prescott, in command, directs Casey Rivers to execute the mooring release procedure.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Taylor Prescott, in command, directs Casey Rivers to execute the mooring release procedure.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers initiates the process to release Harborview Theater from its moorings in response to Taylor Prescott's order.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Casey Rivers initiates the process to release Harborview Theater from its moorings in response to Taylor Prescott's order.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer quietly offers Evan Grayson a tranquilizer, showing concern for his state.
memories.memory_text: I quietly offered Evan Grayson a tranquilizer because I could see he was tense, and I wanted to help him calm down.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer expresses annoyance at being delayed and subtly comments on the situation between Evan Grayson and Casey Rivers.
memories.memory_text: I was annoyed at being delayed and asked who had been holding up the damn elevator, subtly commenting on the awkward tension between Evan Grayson and Casey Rivers.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer brings up Romulan ale, possibly to lighten the mood.
memories.memory_text: I mentioned Romulan ale to lighten the mood, thinking it might ease the tension in the elevator.

grounded_facts: When Graham Mercer makes a comment about Romulan ale, Evan Grayson deflects by referencing the danger of re-opening old wounds, implying emotional history with Elliot York.
memories.memory_text: When I brought up Romulan ale, Evan Grayson responded by warning about the danger of re-opening old wounds, which made me realize he was deflecting something emotional about Elliot York.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson announces he is assuming command by Harbor Point Department order and instructs log entry.
memories.memory_text: I was on the Harborview Theater when Evan Grayson announced he was assuming command by Harbor Point Department order and instructed the duty officer to note it in the ship's log.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson declares an emergency and assumes command of Harborview Theater by order of Harbor Point Department.
Harborview Theater changes course to Fairview Street under Evan Grayson's orders.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Evan Grayson declare an emergency and assume command of Harborview Theater by Harbor Point Department order, and I saw the ship change course to Fairview Street under his orders.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson directly commands Sasha Mercer to engage warp speed at Warp 5.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson tell Sasha Mercer to go to Warp 5.

grounded_facts: Harborview Theater engages warp engines and goes to Warp 5 under Evan Grayson's command.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sasha Mercer engage the warp engines and the ship lurch forward as we went to Warp 5.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson decides to bring Graham Mercer into the discussion and moves the conversation to his quarters.
memories.memory_text: I was told to join Evan Grayson in his quarters for a private discussion, so I went there to be part of the conversation.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson uses his Class 1 security clearance to request and obtain access to the the glass notebook summary from the computer.
memories.memory_text: I watched Evan Grayson request access to the the glass notebook summary using his Class 1 security clearance, and I saw the computer prompt him for a retina scan before he confirmed his identity.

grounded_facts: Taylor Prescott clarifies that if the glass notebook is used on a planet with existing life, it would destroy that life to create a new biosphere.
memories.memory_text: I asked Taylor Prescott what would happen if the glass notebook were used on a planet that already had life, and he told me it would destroy all existing life to make way for a new biosphere.

grounded_facts: After viewing the the glass notebook tape, Taylor Prescott and Graham Mercer debate the scientific and ethical consequences of the technology.
memories.memory_text: I remember watching the the glass notebook tape with Taylor Prescott and Evan Grayson, and being stunned by what I saw — I couldn't believe we were even considering using such a dangerous technology, so I challenged Taylor Prescott about it right away.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer accuses Taylor Prescott of being inhuman for dismissing the moral implications of the glass notebook.
memories.memory_text: I called Taylor Prescott out for being inhuman because he kept hiding behind logic while dismissing the moral horror of universal destruction — I couldn't stay silent when he talked about Armageddon so coldly.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers reports via intercom that the the small photograph is approaching their position.
Casey Rivers informs Evan Grayson via intercom that a vessel, identified as the small photograph, is approaching.
memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Rivers's voice over the intercom telling Evan Grayson that a vessel was closing fast, and then she confirmed it was the small photograph, one of our own ships approaching.

grounded_facts: A medical alert is announced from the Harborview Theater, prompting Graham Mercer to leave urgently.
memories.memory_text: I heard the medical alert from the Harborview Theater and rushed out immediately to respond.

grounded_facts: A post-attack medical emergency in sick bay with multiple casualties and urgent triage.
memories.memory_text: I was in sick bay dealing with a flood of casualties after the attack, scrambling to triage and treat the wounded as best I could.

grounded_facts: Adrian Marlowe succumbs to his injuries after confirming the order for warp speed was given.
Evan Grayson reassures dying Adrian Marlowe that the order for warp speed was executed.
memories.memory_text: I was working on Adrian Marlowe when Evan Grayson came in and told him the warp speed order had been given; I saw Adrian Marlowe die shortly after, knowing his duty was done.

grounded_facts: Logan Davenport confronts Evan Grayson with a silent look and a single word — 'WHY' — expressing grief and implied blame over Adrian Marlowe's death.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Davenport look at Evan Grayson with raw grief and say just one word—'WHY'—after Adrian Marlowe died, and I knew he was blaming Evan Grayson for what happened.

grounded_facts: The Harborview Theater reports that auxiliary power has been restored, enabling impulse propulsion.
memories.memory_text: I was told over the comm that auxiliary power had been restored and we could proceed at impulse power.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson asks Logan Davenport if main power can be restored, seeking options for mission recovery.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Evan Grayson asking Logan Davenport if there was any chance of getting the main power back online as we tried to recover the mission.

grounded_facts: Logan Davenport thanks Graham Mercer for trying to save Adrian Marlowe, showing respect despite loss.
memories.memory_text: I remember Logan Davenport thanking me for trying to save Adrian Marlowe, and he squeezed my shoulder before limping off — a quiet moment of respect after we lost him.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson admits to Graham Mercer that he lost the confrontation with the enemy, surviving only due to superior knowledge of the ship.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Evan Grayson looked me in the eye and admitted he got beat, saying we only survived because he knew something about the ships that the enemy didn't.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers attempts to prevent Evan Grayson from beaming down alone by citing a regulation requiring armed escort for flag officers in hazardous areas.
memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Rivers cite a regulation to try to stop Evan Grayson from beaming down alone, saying something about a flag officer needing an armed escort in a hazardous area.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson rejects Casey Rivers's citation of General Order 15, implying it does not exist, undermining her confidence.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson shut down Casey Rivers's objection by telling her there was no such regulation, and I could tell it shook her confidence.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson, Casey Rivers, and Graham Mercer materialize in Fairview Street on a Fairview Street, initiating their exploration.
memories.memory_text: I materialized in Fairview Street on the Fairview Street with Evan Grayson and Casey Rivers, ready to begin our exploration.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers detects ambiguous biological readings using her tricorder, indicating possible unseen presence.
memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Rivers report indeterminate life signs from her tricorder, so I knew there might be something unseen nearby.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson orders the team to proceed with caution and they begin searching the lab separately.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson order us to move out with the leather case on stun, so I separated from the team and began searching the lab as instructed.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer and later Evan Grayson explore a deserted section of the Fairview Street, discovering signs of a recent massacre.
memories.memory_text: I was exploring the deserted section of the station, feeling uneasy like a scuba diver in a cave, and when a rat startled me, I flinched but told myself I was safe and moved forward.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson expresses stunned disbelief upon recognizing that even the Lane Sterling was killed, emphasizing the brutality of the massacre.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Evan Grayson, sounding stunned, that even the Lane Sterling was killed, which made me realize how brutal the massacre had been.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer discovers five bodies hanging upside down in the Fairview Street, which causes initial shock and fear, later leading to examination of the corpses.
memories.memory_text: I screamed when a human arm suddenly fell on my face, and after Evan Grayson helped me cut down the five bodies hanging upside down, I examined one and told him it looked like a Elliot North.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer reports his medical assessment that the bodies are not warm but lack rigor mortis, indicating the deaths occurred recently.
memories.memory_text: I told Evan Grayson the bodies weren't warm but rigor hadn't set in, which meant the deaths didn't happen all that long ago.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer identifies the dead as known crew members including Riley Wilder, Valerie Colter, the Lane Sterling, and a Elliot North, determining the deaths occurred recently based on body temperature and absence of rigor mortis.
memories.memory_text: I examined the corpses and recognized Riley Wilder, Valerie Colter, the Lane Sterling, and a Elliot North — all crew members — and noted they weren't warm and hadn't stiffened yet, so I knew the deaths happened recently.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers, Evan Grayson, and Graham Mercer discover the unconscious bodies of Finley Hollis and Darian Hollis after hearing a moan and detecting unusual readings on a tricorder.
memories.memory_text: I heard a moan and we followed it with Casey Rivers and Evan Grayson, then opened a door to find Finley Hollis and Darian Hollis lying there unconscious—I knew right away they were in bad shape and needed my help as their doctor.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer examines Finley Hollis and Darian Hollis with a medical tricorder and determines they are suffering from a drug-induced brain disturbance.
memories.memory_text: I examined Finley Hollis and Darian Hollis with my medical tricorder and determined they were suffering from a drug-induced brain disturbance.

grounded_facts: Darian Hollis wakes up and recognizes Graham Mercer.
memories.memory_text: I saw Darian Hollis open his eyes and stare at me when he woke up.

grounded_facts: Darian Hollis tells Evan Grayson that the the glass notebook materials and data banks are gone.
Darian Hollis informs Evan Grayson that Elliot Carver could not find the the glass notebook materials, which are gone along with data banks.
memories.memory_text: I heard Darian Hollis tell Evan Grayson that the the glass notebook materials and data banks were gone, and that Elliot Carver couldn't find them.

grounded_facts: Darian Hollis, with Finley Hollis, requests to join Evan Grayson's team despite the danger.
memories.memory_text: I was present when Darian Hollis and Finley Hollis asked Evan Grayson if they could join the team despite the danger, and I saw Evan Grayson agree to let them come along.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson and team prepare to beam down to the coordinates on Fairview Street, despite uncertainty about the destination.
memories.memory_text: I helped prepare to beam down to Fairview Street with Evan Grayson's team, and though we weren't sure what we'd find, I stood ready and transported with them when Casey Rivers confirmed we were set to go.

grounded_facts: Elliot York tells Noel Vale that Evan Grayson is his father, halting the immediate threat of violence.
Elliot York discloses that Evan Grayson is Noel Vale's biological father, fundamentally altering the emotional and relational dynamics between them.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Elliot York told Noel Vale that Evan Grayson was his father, and I saw how it stopped the fight and changed everything between them.

grounded_facts: Noel Vale ambushes Evan Grayson, tackling him and holding a knife to his throat, accusing him of causing the deaths of Fairview Street scientists.
Noel Vale confronts Evan Grayson, blaming him for the deaths of the Fairview Street scientists, intensifying hostilities.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Vale ambush Evan Grayson, tackling him and holding a knife to his throat while shouting that Evan Grayson was responsible for the deaths of the Fairview Street scientists, and I heard him tell Elliot York he was going to kill him.

grounded_facts: Darian Hollis confirms his loyalty to Elliot Carver by reporting the situation, establishing Elliot Carver's indirect control over the scene.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Darian Hollis's report over the communicator that he was loyal to Elliot Carver, confirming Elliot Carver now had control of the situation.

grounded_facts: Darian Hollis disarms Morgan Mercer and reveals his allegiance to Elliot Carver by reporting to him via communicator, shifting the power balance in the cavern.
memories.memory_text: I saw Darian Hollis disarm Morgan Mercer and then speak into his communicator, reporting to Elliot Carver, which made it clear the power in the cavern had shifted.

grounded_facts: When Noel Vale lunges at Darian Hollis, Darian Hollis reflexively fires his the leather case, killing Morgan Mercer who was behind Noel Vale.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Vale lunge at Darian Hollis, and in response, Darian Hollis reflexively fired his the leather case, accidentally hitting and killing Morgan Mercer who was standing behind Noel Vale.

grounded_facts: Elliot Carver orders Darian Hollis to assassinate Evan Grayson, exploiting his mental control.
Elliot Carver attempts to command Darian Hollis and Finley Hollis to kill Evan Grayson from a distance via communicator.
memories.memory_text: I heard Elliot Carver order Darian Hollis to kill Evan Grayson through the communicator, trying to command him from a distance while I watched in horror.

grounded_facts: Darian Hollis kills himself under Elliot Carver's command after resisting the order to kill Evan Grayson.
memories.memory_text: I saw Darian Hollis turn his the leather case on himself and fire, killing himself after resisting Elliot Carver's order to assassinate Evan Grayson.

grounded_facts: The Ceti eel emerges from Finley Hollis's ear and is destroyed by Evan Grayson.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Ceti eel crawl out of Finley Hollis's ear, and I watched Evan Grayson destroy it with a the leather case right after it emerged.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson grabs the wrist recorder used by Elliot Carver to issue commands.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson grab the wrist recorder from Elliot Carver after he destroyed the eel.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson seizes the communicator and directly challenges Elliot Carver after destroying the eel and losing Darian Hollis.
memories.memory_text: I saw Evan Grayson seize the communicator and directly challenge Elliot Carver, shouting at him after Darian Hollis was lost.

grounded_facts: Finley Hollis stirs and moans, attempting to sit up, indicating he is alive and recovering from injury.
Survivors regroup in a rocky cavern after a battle, assessing injuries, communication, and survival options.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Hollis stir and moan as we all regrouped in the rocky cavern, and I called out, 'He's alive!'—knowing we had to assess his injuries and figure out our next move for survival.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers reports that all channels are still jammed, making contact with Harborview Theater impossible.
memories.memory_text: I heard Casey Rivers report that all channels were still jammed, so we couldn't make contact with Harborview Theater.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer states that if Harborview Theater obeyed orders, it has left; if it didn't, it is likely destroyed.
memories.memory_text: I told the others that if Harborview Theater obeyed orders, she's long gone, and if she didn't, then she's finished.

grounded_facts: Noel Vale expresses bitterness toward Evan Grayson, blaming him for a man's death due to prior actions.
memories.memory_text: I heard Noel Vale blame Evan Grayson for another man's death, saying it was because of him.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer sharply corrects Noel Vale, blaming him for causing two deaths by rushing a man with a primed the leather case.
memories.memory_text: I told Noel Vale the man's death was on him for rushing someone with a primed the leather case, and that it wasn't one death but two.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson asks about food, redirecting the group's attention from despair to practical survival.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson ask if anyone had food because he was starved, and that shifted everyone's focus from despair to survival.

grounded_facts: Elliot York informs the group that there is ample food in the the glass notebook cave, sufficient to last a lifetime.
memories.memory_text: I remember Elliot York saying there's food in the the glass notebook cave, enough to last a lifetime if we need it.

grounded_facts: Elliot York asks Noel Vale to show Graham Mercer and Casey Rivers the food source in the the glass notebook cave.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Elliot York asked Noel Vale to show me and Casey Rivers the food source in the the glass notebook cave.

grounded_facts: Noel Vale is asked by Elliot York and then reluctantly agrees to show Graham Mercer and Casey Rivers the food in the the glass notebook cave.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Vale hesitate but then reluctantly agree to take me and Casey Rivers to see the food in the the glass notebook cave.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson responds to Casey Rivers's unspoken concern by quoting Taylor Prescott, affirming belief in possibilities despite dire circumstances.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson quote Taylor Prescott, saying he likes to think there are always possibilities, as Casey Rivers hesitated to leave.

grounded_facts: A conversation initiated by Casey Rivers about the Kobayashi Maru test, leading to a discussion on facing defeat and Evan Grayson's past actions.
memories.memory_text: I remember Casey Rivers bringing up the Kobayashi Maru, and me reflecting on how it tests a commander's philosophy toward defeat.

grounded_facts: The moment when Evan Grayson contacts Taylor Prescott to coordinate their beam-out from the the glass notebook Cave.
memories.memory_text: I recall Evan Grayson contacting Taylor Prescott from the the glass notebook Cave to coordinate our beam-out, checking if they were ready on schedule.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson directly answers Casey Rivers's question about the Kobayashi Maru test by revealing he reprogrammed it, satisfying her curiosity and reinforcing his character.
Evan Grayson discloses that he beat the no-win scenario by reprogramming the simulation, revealing his aversion to losing and demonstrating unconventional problem-solving.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson tell Casey Rivers that he reprogrammed the Kobayashi Maru simulation to make it winnable, saying he doesn't like to lose and earned a commendation for original thinking.

grounded_facts: A group arrives on Harborview Theater via transporter, initiating a reunion and immediate tactical discussion.
Evan Grayson, Noel Vale, Casey Rivers, Elliot York, Graham Mercer, and the semi-conscious Finley Hollis materialize in the transporter room.
memories.memory_text: I arrived with Evan Grayson, Noel Vale, Casey Rivers, Elliot York, and the semi-conscious Finley Hollis in the transporter room, where Taylor Prescott greeted us.

grounded_facts: Evan Grayson reminds Casey Rivers of Regulation 46-A regarding coded messages during battle, justifying the communication strategy.
memories.memory_text: I heard Evan Grayson remind Casey Rivers about Regulation 46-A regarding coded messages during battle, justifying how Taylor Prescott communicated.

grounded_facts: Casey Rivers directly accuses Taylor Prescott of lying about the ship's status after recalling regulations.
Casey Rivers accuses Taylor Prescott of lying about the ship's status; Taylor Prescott clarifies he exaggerated, not lied.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Casey Rivers accuse Taylor Prescott of lying about the ship's status, and then Taylor Prescott responded that he had exaggerated, not lied.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer announces he is taking Finley Hollis and possibly others to sick bay.
Graham Mercer announces he is taking Finley Hollis to sick bay for medical care.
memories.memory_text: I announced that I'm taking this bunch, including Finley Hollis, to sick bay for medical care.

grounded_facts: An emergency situation in the hospital triggered by a light change and sirens, with medical and civilian personnel reacting.
memories.memory_text: I saw the lights change and heard the sirens go off, and I noticed medical and civilian personnel reacting around me while I was working on Finley Hollis.

grounded_facts: Noel Vale decides to go up to the location where the light change and sirens are coming from.
memories.memory_text: I remember Noel Vale saying he was going up toward the area where the sirens were coming from.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer advises Noel Vale not to go up, stating that he would be in the way.
memories.memory_text: I told Noel Vale he would be in the way if he went up, and advised him to stay where he was.

grounded_facts: Finley Hollis wakes and attempts to get up despite physical weakness, showing urgency.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finley Hollis wake up and look around wildly, and he told me, 'But I must --' as he tried to get up despite being weak.

grounded_facts: Graham Mercer advises Finley Hollis not to move due to lack of strength and equilibrium.
